title: Covered Losses and Payoff Exclusions, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda
content:
# Covered Losses and Payoff Exclusions, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda

The Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda pay a GAP balance benefit only on the losses each waiver covers, and leave out of the payoff the items each waiver excludes. The switches below are fixed per waiver; "Yes" means the rule applies to that waiver.

## Covered losses

| Waiver | Primary physical-damage insurance settlement required | Only total losses covered | Loss declared for mechanical breakdown excluded | Benefit paid to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | Yes | Yes | Yes | lienholder |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | Yes | Yes | Yes | lienholder |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | Yes | Yes | Yes | lienholder |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 | Yes | Yes | Yes | lienholder |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 | Yes | Yes | Yes | lienholder |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 | Yes | Yes | Yes | lienholder |

## Payoff items subtracted from the benefit

| Waiver | Past-due payments | Late fees and charges | Deferred or extended payments | Refunds of cancelled financed products | Negative trade equity carried into the contract | Salvage value deducted for an owner-retained vehicle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Meaning of each switch

- **Primary insurance settlement required** — whether a primary physical-damage insurance settlement is required for a benefit.
- **Only total losses covered** — whether partial losses are left out.
- **Mechanical breakdown excluded** — whether a vehicle declared a loss for mechanical breakdown is excluded.
- **Past-due payments / late fees and charges / deferred or extended payments / refunds of cancelled financed products / negative trade equity / retained salvage value** — each "Yes" means that item, where it is part of the lienholder's payoff or the claim, is subtracted from the benefit; "No" means it is left in.
- **Benefit paid to** — who receives the GAP balance benefit; for every waiver, the lienholder.

## Reading the differences

The waivers differ only in two payoff items. Negative trade equity is subtracted under the Kessler GAP Waiver 125, Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 and Kessler GAP Commercial 130, and left in under the other three. Deferred or extended payments are left in under the Kessler GAP Plus 150 and Kessler GAP Plus 175, and subtracted under the other four.
